title: Jensen Huang Returns to Work
content:
Geoff Weiss, reporting for Business Insider:

Nvidia employees gathered at headquarters to mark the moment, chanting “Jensen! Jensen!” as he arrived back at the office, according to a person familiar with the scene. The crowd was so packed that employees jostled for a glimpse. Rather than his signature black leather jacket, the source said he appeared to be wearing a navy cotton coat.

Huang put his hand on his heart several times and said, “This is my first day at work,” according to a video of the scene. “I’m terribly sorry for putting all of you through all of this.”

“I’m gonna be a better CEO the second time around,” he said, according to another person in attendance.

Gavin Baker, on X, has video and photos of Huang addressing hundreds of cheering employees.

Huang went on to promise that he’ll now engage in sexual affairs with only one supplier or employee at a time.
